Bug: merchant clicks Content Manager > Create post with AI, spinner never ends, no credit deducted. Root cause found in code: the AI writer streams POST /langgraph/blog (controllers/langGraphController.js `generate`, ~line 42) as SSE. The LLM call is `chatModel.stream(lcMessages)` at langgraph/nodes/callModelNode.js:313 iterated with `for await (const chunk of stream)` at ~:412 with NO idle timeout; the ChatOpenAI client (langgraph/models/openAiChatModel.js) has no `timeout`. When OpenRouter holds the connection open without sending chunks, generation waits until the 540s Cloud Function kill, and the controller writes nothing between `ready` and the first blog_chunk, so the browser cannot tell a slow stream from a dead one.

Do:
1. New helper packages/functions/src/helpers/withIdleTimeout.js, pure JS, no deps, usable from both Node and the browser (the React app imports @functions/helpers/* already): `export async function* withIdleTimeout(iterable, ms, {onTimeout} = {})` — yields every item of the async iterable; if no item arrives within `ms` after the previous one (or after start), call `onTimeout()` if given, call `iterator.return?.()` best-effort (don't await forever on it), and throw an Error whose `code` is 'STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT' and message says no data for N ms. Always clear the timer (no leaked timers when the consumer breaks early or the source throws). Export the code constant too.
2. callModelNode.js: create an AbortController, pass `{signal}` as the 2nd arg to `chatModel.stream(lcMessages, {signal})`, and iterate `withIdleTimeout(stream, LLM_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS, {onTimeout: () => controller.abort()})`. LLM_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS = 60000 (export it, define near the node). The thrown error must propagate so the controller's existing catch writes the SSE `error` event (it already does; don't change that catch).
3. openAiChatModel.js: add `timeout: 60000` (ms, covers waiting for response headers per attempt) and `maxRetries: 2` to the ChatOpenAI options so a dead upstream cannot burn the 540s budget across LangChain's default 6 retries. One-line why-comment.
4. langGraphController.js `generate`: after `writeEvent({type: 'ready'})`, start `setInterval` writing the SSE comment `:ping\n\n` every 15000 ms (skip when ctx.res.writableEnded; call ctx.res.flush if present, same as writeEvent). Clear it in the existing `finally` and in the `close` handler. Comment the why in one line: the browser's idle watchdog needs bytes while the server is legitimately busy (image generation, outline planning).
5. Tests (jest, fake timers or real short ms):
   - packages/functions/src/helpers/__tests__/withIdleTimeout.test.js: passes through items; throws code STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT and calls onTimeout when a source stalls; does not throw for a source that is slow but under the limit between items; no pending timer after normal completion and after early break; propagates source errors unchanged.
   - extend packages/functions/src/langgraph/nodes/__tests__/callModelNode.test.js: a chatModel whose stream yields one chunk then never resolves -> node rejects with code STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT and the signal passed to stream() is aborted (use jest.useFakeTimers or mock the constant via a small timeout — choose what works with jest 24). Keep existing tests passing.
   - packages/functions/src/controllers/__tests__/langGraphController.heartbeat.test.js ONLY IF the controller can be imported in jest with mocks of its imports; if that is impractical, skip this test and say why in your final message.

Rules: touch only files in the contract allow list. Comments say WHY only, never narrate WHAT; no step numbering, no banners; no console.log. No new dependencies. Do not change credit deduction logic or the shape of existing SSE events. Run the verify commands yourself before saying done. Final message: file:line of each change and the test output.

Separately, mutation onError (:346-352) only sets status 'error' with no toast (the page goes blank — merchant sees nothing), and the auth handshake failure at :486-489 silently sets status 'idle'.

The previous task added packages/functions/src/helpers/withIdleTimeout.js (`withIdleTimeout(iterable, ms, {onTimeout})`, throws Error with code 'STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT'); read it and reuse it, do not duplicate it. The server now sends an SSE `:ping` comment every 15s, which processSSEResponse yields as a chunk, so any chunk counts as liveness.
